summary: Quest Diagnostics filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $500M public offering of 5.000% senior notes due 2036 under its shelf registration. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of $500M 3.45% senior notes maturing June 1, 2026. Closing is expected May 6, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Underwriters include Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Mizuho. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No special-situation designation applies.
